text:
elaine: Heads-up — prospect (FiscalBank Inc) wants an air-gapped POC for on-prem inference. Primary asks: sealed bundle delivery, signed provenance, offline activation flow, upgrade cadence, rollback plan, and pricing for sealed-environment ops. Need cross-team input.

jonah: Quick checklist from SE side: bootstrap ISO, offline agent bundle (tarball), signed SBOM, install runbook, verification commands, and a delta/patch mechanism. Also need to confirm whether they expect us to supply a KMS/HSM appliance or use their on-prem KMS.

priya: Commercial Qs: will they buy committed nodes or expect a consumption meter? For sealed deployments we normally do reserved-node pricing + a sealed-environment support uplift. I need estimated GPU count and an expected patching SLA to craft a sketch quote.

marco: Packaging notes: prefer a layered artifact model: core runtime layer (small), model artifact layer (large), and patches/deltas. For security, every artifact signed with our code-signing key. Delta patches for runtime/config can be small; model swaps usually require full artifact unless chunked overlay is acceptable. Suggested cadence: security patches as-needed, monthly critical patch bundles, quarterly feature bundles. If customer requires weekly security pushes, we can do an expedited delivery at extra charge.

marcus-legal: Legal side: we'll need an On-Prem Addendum outlining permitted use, support boundaries, and tamper-evidence requirements. Also export control check on models (some weights are restricted). For activation we need to know if they want offline license activation (signed activation token) or license server behind their firewall. Also add clauses for signed SBOM and attestations.

annah-ops: Runbook & rollback: make POC non-destructive by default — avoid irreversible DB schema migrations. If migrations are necessary, include snapshot/backup + offline migration plan. Acceptance test flow: smoke tests -> perf test (tokens/sec) -> canary restore window 30m. Rollback steps: reapply previous bundle, purge KV/prefix cache, restart agents; document exact systemd/service commands and file paths.

deploy-bot: package-builder: generated redwood-sealed-2026-06.tar.gz sha256=ee5b3a9f4c2d1a7b9c8d0e2f6a7b4c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j1k2l3m (sig=redwood-202606.sig)

jonah: Verification examples we will hand to customer:
```
cosign verify-blob --signature redwood-202606.sig redwood-sealed-2026-06.tar.gz
sha256sum redwood-sealed-2026-06.tar.gz | grep ee5b3a9f
```
We also include an example SBOM.json and the public key bundle in the manifest.

marco: Note on model updates: if they want model tuning iterations during the POC, we need to plan for either full model bundles or a chunked overlay approach — latter requires agent support and increases complexity. This impacts delivery cadence and cost.

priya: SOW items to include for the initial 6-month trial: delivery of signed bundle, 2 remote install assist sessions (or 1 onsite at rate), 30 days of post-install support, option for managed patching (recurring fee). I'll prepare a ballpark with committed-node pricing + sealed-environment uplift.

marcus-legal: Audit & compliance: confirm retention window for logs/audit exports. If they request SSO (SAML) in an air-gapped site we need to document a cert exchange and connector pattern; include fallback for manual user provisioning if connector isn't possible.

elaine: Action items: @jonah assemble the POC deliverable checklist + verification snippets by EOD Fri; @priya draft the initial commercial sketch for 6 months; @marcus-legal surface required clauses and export checks; @annah-ops create rollback runbook skeleton and acceptance test list. I'll set up a 30-min sync with FiscalBank for next Tue.

jonah: I'll include example manifests, SBOM sample, and a minimal install playbook showing offline activation token flow.

priya: I'll pull numbers from the offline matrix and include expedited patch pricing and on-site options.

marcus-legal: I'll flag any model export issues and start the addendum draft.

annah-ops: I'll draft the rollback script and include step-by-step commands and a checklist for DB snapshot/restore.

elaine: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll post the meeting invite once scheduled.
